description: Thumbnail grid with lightbox viewer. Progressive enhancement: thumbnails link to full images without JS. With JS, opens a native <dialog> lightbox with prev/next, keyboard (direction-aware), swipe, and View Transitions.

attributes.name: columns
attributes.description: Minimum column width for the thumbnail grid.

attributes.name: controls
attributes.description: Lightbox control layout. 'edge' puts prev/next on the sides with a floating header, 'bar' moves prev/next into the top bar, 'minimal' shows close only (swipe/keyboard to navigate). Changing it rebuilds the lightbox on next open.

attributes.name: captions
attributes.description: Caption display in the lightbox. 'auto' adds an info button in a footer that toggles the caption text (hidden attribute), 'overlay' shows the caption under the image, 'hidden' suppresses it. Changing it rebuilds the lightbox on next open.

attributes.name: transition
attributes.description: View Transition type. 'morph' animates thumbnail to full image, 'fade' cross-fades, 'none' disables.

attributes.name: data-label-dialog
attributes.description: Accessible name of the lightbox dialog.

attributes.name: data-label-show-details
attributes.description: Info button name while the caption is collapsed (captions="auto").

attributes.name: data-label-hide-details
attributes.description: Info button name while the caption is expanded (captions="auto").

attributes.name: data-label-counter
attributes.description: Counter text template, announced politely on navigation; {n} and {total} are replaced.

events.name: image-gallery:images-changed
events.description: Fired after the images setter rebuilds the gallery.

properties.name: images
properties.description: Get the image set (caption is a string for text-only captions, a cloned DocumentFragment for markup, or null) or assign one to rebuild the thumbnails. String captions render as text, never HTML; pass a Node, DocumentFragment or <template> for rich captions. Assigning closes an open lightbox and fires image-gallery:images-changed with source 'property'.

methods.name: open(index)
methods.description: Open the lightbox at a zero-based index (no-op when out of range).

methods.name: close()
methods.description: Close the lightbox (with the morph transition when enabled).

methods.name: next()
methods.description: Show the next image (wraps with loop).

methods.name: prev()
methods.description: Show the previous image (wraps with loop).

structure.description: Image-only item: anchor wrapping a thumbnail img.
Rich item: figure wrapping an anchor and figcaption.
Thumbnail image inside anchor. src is the thumbnail, parent anchor href is the full image.
Optional caption inside figure. Supports HTML including links; its nodes are cloned into the lightbox.
